knowledgePoints.title: 一、常见不规则动词变化
knowledgePoints.content: 不规则动词的变化形式需要记忆，分为几种类型：

subPoints.title: AAA型（原形、过去式、过去分词相同）
subPoints.content: cut-cut-cut, put-put-put, let-let-let, hit-hit-hit, set-set-set, cost-cost-cost, hurt-hurt-hurt

subPoints.title: ABB型（过去式和过去分词相同）
subPoints.content: buy-bought-bought, bring-brought-brought, think-thought-thought, catch-caught-caught, teach-taught-taught, fight-fought-fought

subPoints.title: ABA型（原形和过去分词相同）
ABC型（三种形式都不相同）
subPoints.content: go-went-gone, do-did-done, see-saw-seen, eat-ate-eaten, give-gave-given, take-took-taken

subPoints.title: AB型和ABC型特殊情况
subPoints.content:
lie-lay-lain（躺）, lay-laid-laid（放）, lie-lied-lied（说谎）
sink-sank-sunk, drink-drank-drunk
begin-began-begun, ring-rang-rung
swim-swam-swum, sing-sang-sung

knowledgePoints.title: 二、重点不规则动词
knowledgePoints.content: 需要特别注意的不规则动词：

subPoints.title: 容易混淆的动词
subPoints.content:
fall-fell-fallen（落下）, feel-felt-felt（感觉）
find-found-found（发现）, found-founded-founded（建立）
wind-wound-wound（缠绕）, wound-wounded-wounded（受伤）

subPoints.title: 特殊变化
subPoints.content:
choose-chose-chosen, freeze-froze-frozen
speak-spoke-spoken, steal-stole-stolen
tear-tore-torn, wear-wore-worn
fly-flew-flown, grow-grew-grown
know-knew-known, throw-threw-thrown
write-wrote-written, drive-drove-driven
rise-rose-risen, arise-arose-arisen

exercises.question: By the time we arrived, the meeting had already ___________ (begin).
She ___________ (swim) across the river yesterday and felt exhausted.
exercises.explanation: swim是不规则动词，过去式是swam

exercises.question: The children ___________ (hide) behind the tree before the teacher saw them.
exercises.explanation: hide是不规则动词，过去分词是hidden

exercises.question: The letter ___________ (write) in French needs to be translated.
exercises.explanation: write是不规则动词，过去分词是written

exercises.question: The ancient vase was ___________ (break) into pieces during the earthquake.
exercises.explanation: break是不规则动词，过去分词是broken

exercises.question: He ___________ (choose) to stay home instead of attending the party.
exercises.explanation: choose是不规则动词，过去式是chose

exercises.question: The thief ___________ (steal) the painting before the guards noticed.
exercises.explanation: steal是不规则动词，过去分词是stolen

exercises.question: The song ___________ (sing) by the choir moved everyone to tears.
exercises.explanation: sing是不规则动词，过去分词是sung

exercises.question: She has ___________ (wear) the same dress to three events this month.
exercises.explanation: wear是不规则动词，过去分词是worn

exercises.question: The bridge ___________ (build) last year can withstand heavy storms.
exercises.explanation: build是不规则动词，过去式是built
